description: Welcome to CodeRumble 4.0! CodeRumble 4.0 is the flagship annual programming contest hosted by The Programming Club of IIITDMJ. This ICPC Regional-style team contest invites programming enthusiasts to test their skills in a competitive, completely offline environment while gaining insights from esteemed professionals in the field through speaker sessions. Please follow the official registration guide to complete the overall process. Ensure that all team members verify their accounts before attempting to access the extended form; once two or three members have completed verification, click on Update Details to generate the extended form, which must then be fully filled only by the team leader to finalize your submission. Event Highlights: Format: Experience the excitement of an ICPC Regional-style contest. Duration: One 5-hour round. Challenges: Solve 10-12 problems designed to push your coding skills to the limit. Prize Pool: Compete for a share of the INR 20,000 prize pool! Whether you’re teaming up with classmates or collaborating with programmers from different colleges and specializations, CodeRumble offers a rigorous and rewarding offline competition experience. We look forward to seeing you at CodeRumble and witnessing your coding brilliance!
organiser: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM), Jabalpur

raw.details:
Welcome to CodeRumble 4.0!

CodeRumble 4.0 is the flagship annual programming contest hosted by The Programming Club of IIITDMJ. This ICPC Regional-style team contest invites programming enthusiasts to test their skills in a competitive, completely offline environment while gaining insights from esteemed professionals in the field through speaker sessions.

Please follow the official registration guide to complete the overall process. Ensure that all team members verify their accounts before attempting to access the extended form; once two or three members have completed verification, click on Update Details to generate the extended form, which must then be fully filled only by the team leader to finalize your submission.

Event Highlights:

  • Format: Experience the excitement of an ICPC Regional-style contest.
  • Duration: One 5-hour round.
  • Challenges: Solve 10-12 problems designed to push your coding skills to the limit.
  • Prize Pool: Compete for a share of the INR 20,000 prize pool!

Whether you’re teaming up with classmates or collaborating with programmers from different colleges and specializations, CodeRumble offers a rigorous and rewarding offline competition experience.

We look forward to seeing you at CodeRumble and witnessing your coding brilliance!
